title: PendingAlerts v1
description: pending-alerts.json in the app data folder (SPEC Revision 1, item 3): the minimal record that lets a waiting-for-you alert survive an app restart. Written only by the core, atomically, whenever the set of needs_you agents changes. On start the collector restores each record as a needs_you agent with confidence inferred, shows that it is unconfirmed, and clears it on the first fresh signal for that agent or request (an answer, a new turn, a session end) or when the agent's session is gone. Ids and enums only: no text, no paths. The keyword x-unique-by lists item keys that must be unique across an array (see contracts/CHANGES.md).

alerts.description: One record per agent waiting on the user; empty when nobody waits.

ms.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC), always an integer. The range (2000-01-01 to 2100-01-01) rejects a seconds value passed by mistake.

instance.description: A salted hash, never a raw id: 32 lowercase hex characters. A raw UUID cannot match this pattern.

request_id.description: The request the alert is keyed by, or null when the source gave none (then the agent is the key).

last_confirmed_at.description: The last time a fresh signal confirmed the wait (at least since).
